steps.title: Light reactions
steps.source_text: Chlorophyll in the thylakoid membrane absorbs light and splits water, releasing oxygen and storing energy in ATP and NADPH for later use.

steps.title: The Calvin cycle
steps.source_text: In the stroma the enzyme rubisco fixes carbon dioxide onto a five carbon sugar, and the ATP made earlier drives the loop that builds glucose.
